tei:div.tei:p: 363) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: lha mo'i sgrub thabs dngos grub mchog stsol dbang gi lcags kyu me tog phreng mdzes bzhugs so: 364) (Dakini secret letter here) na mo dzñā na ḍā ki ye:

sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: ma 'ongs padma'i rjes 'jug skyes bu yis: don gnyis sgrub phyir 'khor 'das dbang sdud thabs: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa zab mo ni: rlung sems dbang sdud dbang gi lcags kyu bstan: sa ma ya: de nas sbyor ba'i rim pa ni: mtshan ldan bhandha yid 'ong nang: bdud rtsi nus ldan thabs kyis bsgyur: sbyor ba'i dwangs ma'i gsos btab ste: gsang rdzas gnyis kyi kha bsgyur nas: rdo rje sems dpa'i me long la: chos 'byung zur lnga'i dbus su oṃ: rtsibs la srog gi snying po ni: rigs lnga'i sa bon 'bru re bkod: kha khaibs 365) dang bcas dal dbus bzhugs: dar dmar gur phub sku brnyan sogs: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bkram: phyi nang gsang mchod la sogs dang: bkra shis phun tshogs rten rdzas bshams: sgrub pa'i grogs dang rdzas yo byad: nyams pa'i skyon bral legs par bsags: sa ma ya: phyi nang mtshams bcad dam du bya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: rang rig gdod nas sangs rgyas la: ma rig bral bar skyabs su mchi: bde gshegs snying pos 'gro la khyab: rang zhal mjal bar sems bskyed do: lan gsum dang: tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ rgyal yum dbang gi lha mo la: rang bzhin dag pas ye phyag 'tshal: 366)snang ba ma spangs rgyan mchod 'bul: mtha' bral chos dbyings klong du bshags: gnyis med don la yi rang ngo: theg gsum chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: gzhon nu bum skur bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'khor gsum 'dzin bral dbyings su bsngo: 'ja' lus zang thal mchog 'grub shog: de nas maṇḍal 'bul ba ni: trām̐: rang lus maṇḍal dbang pos brgyan: rin chen maṇḍal yid 'ong ldan: chos dbyings maṇḍal thig les brgyan: sor rtogs ye shes dkyil 'khor lhar: gus pas 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: trām̐ ratna maṇḍal la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: tshogs zhing 'od du zhu nas rang la bsdus:

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de nas mtshams lha bskyed pa ni: oṃ badzra kro ta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: rang nyid gzhi lus dpal rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa: zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bsgrad pa: sku la dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa: ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher bas log 'dren 'byung po'i 367)rigs su gyur pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gyis gnon par bskyed do: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen rol pa'i gzhal yas nas: bgegs 'dul dpa' bo skur bzhengs shig: log 'dren 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: dam tshig lha dang gnyis med bzhugs: hrīḥbadzra kro ta hya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bgegs rnams skad cig yud tsam gyis 'dir 'dus par bsam: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.a karsha ya dzaḥ de nas bgegs gtor byin brlab ni: oṃ swa bhā wa sogasaḥ stong pa'i ngang las trāṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma so so'i 'dod pa tshims pa'i gter chen po nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa sogs: hūm̐: oṃ a ka ro sogs: phaṭaswā hāḥ de nas bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni padma dbang gi sku: he ru ka dpal bgegs kyi gshed: log 'dren 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogs: gnas 'dir ma 'dug phyir dengs shig: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar song: bdag gi bka' las 'da' byed rnams: khro tshogs mtshon chas rdul du brlag: 368)de bas ma gnas phyir dengs shig: na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden pa dang: rnal 'byor bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa dang: khyad par du ye shes mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyi bden pa'i mthus: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyen po sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bar chad 'byung po bgegs tshogs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis mgu zhing tshims par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig:

gang dag mi 'gro zhing 'dug par gyur pa thams cad khro tshogs mtshon cha me dpung 'bar bas bsregs shing brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za bas na so so rang rang gi gnas su phyir dengs shig: rtsa sngags dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad: de nas srung gur bsgom pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: ye shes lnga yi phyag rgya'i gur: phyi nang bar med chen por gnas: kun brtags gdon gyis glags mi snyed: oṃ bhrūm̐ badzra ratna padma karma tika kṣa dzwa la sarba rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: de nas brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig khyab brdal chos sku'i klong: ma bcos gdod nas rang byung ba: ye shes chen por lhun gyis grubaḥ 369)'khor 'das chos skur brda sgo dbye: badzra tsitta pra we sha ya hoḥ de nas brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ye nas rang rig lha dang gnyis su med: bdag 'dzin spros pa mtha' dag dbyings su grol: sgyu ma chu zla'i rol gar ji bzhin du: brda dang brda lan tshul gyis ye phyag 'tshal: na mo na ma hoḥ de nas dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi lha: rang zhal so mar mjal ba'i phyir: bde chen sor rtogs ye shes lha: srog gi gtar bzung bsgrub par bya: badzra tsitta āḥ de nas byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min bde chen pho brang nas: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang: 'od snang mtha' yas byin phob cig: ri bo gru 'dzin pho brang nas: snying rje'i mnga' bdag mes chen po: spyan ras gzigs dbang= rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: rgyal kun phrin las dpal mnga' ba: padma thod phreng= bde stong mchog gi pho brang nas: gsang sngags bka' yi gsang mdzod 'dzin: ye shes mtsho rgyal= gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang nas: dregs pa dbang sdud he ru ka: padma gar dbang= lho phyogs dbang gi 370)pho brang nas: khams gsum dbang bsgyur mkha' 'gro ma: rig byed lha mos= thun mong khams gsum dbang sdud cing:

mchog tu rig 'dzin rnam bzhi 'grub: 'ja' lus chos sku'i byin chen phobs: gzhon nu bum sku'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥ badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ a be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ de nas mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa mchod pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang gsum 'dod yon sprin: sman gtor rakta lha mor bcas: rab 'byams zhing kun gang bar gyur: oṃ ma hā sarba pū dza pañtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye nas lha dang gnyis med kyang: ma rig dbang gis tha dad bzung: sgrib gsum bag chags ci mchis kun: dag chen chos dbyings klong du bshags: sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ de nas dngos gzhi lha yi ting 'dzin ni: āḥ ka dag brjod bral de bzhin nyid: kun snang 'gro la snying rjer brdal: thugs rje'i rtsal snang cho 'phrul du: padma dbang gi gzhal yas khang: lhun grub bkod pa rdzogs pa'i dbus: pad nyi'i steng du rang rig ni: hrīḥ 371)yig dmar po gsal ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: yongs gyur rang nyid skad cig gis: rig byed lha mo zhal gcig pa: spyan gsum sku gsum dbyings su gzigs: dbu skra gyen 'khyil thod skam lnga'i: rin chen rtse bran dar gyis brgyan: phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis ni: utpal dmar po'i mda' gzhu 'gengs: yon tan yongs su rdzogs phyir ro: mtha' gnyis khams gsum dbang sdud cing: dngos grub mchog tu brnyes pa'i phyir: padma'i lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: 'dzin pa rang grol dar dpyangs dang: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: tshogs drug gnas dag rus rgyan gsol: nyon mongs rang grol stag sham dkris: sems byung lnga bcu dag pa yi: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dpyangs: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums g.yon brkyang nas: pad nyi bam gyi snying gar brdzis: spyi bor rigs bdag snang mtha' yas: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs: ye shes med pung 'khyil klong 'gying:

de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥdang thugs kar 372)hūm̐: de las 'od 'phros rab 'byams kyi: rgyal kun thugs rgyud ye shes bskul: dbang gi lha mo'i rnam pa ru: dwangs pa'i mtsho la char rgyun bzhin: sib sib thim nas gnyis med gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ padma ka ma la ye st+wam̐: de nas spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nub phyogs sor rtogs ye shes dbyings: padma dbang gi gzhal yas nas: khams gsum dbang bsdud bcom ldan ma: rig byed lha mo rgyal ba'i yum: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs: 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs: mos bzhi dbang du bsdu phyir= mchog gi dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs: rnal 'byor sgo gsum dag smin cing: rdzogs pa mthar phyin gshegs su gsol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥ badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes dbyings nas gshegs pa'i lha: dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du: 'ub chub klong du gnyis med bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug che: 373)bcom ldan rig byed lha mo yi: sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag gi sgo gsum dad pa yis: rtse gcig yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ kun 'byung nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: sgyu 'phrul mchod pa bsam mi khyab: mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul: dri zhim bdug spos shangs la= snang gsal mar me spyan la= ro mchog zhal zas ljags la= snyan pa'i rol mo snyan la= nyon mongs gnas dag nang mchod 'bul: gnyis med mchog gi gsang mchod= phyag rgya glu gar mchod pa= bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥsarba sa pā ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ= shapda rū pa shapda gandhe ra sa sparshe sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sarba pū dza khā hiḥ

de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ padma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin yid 'ong ma: mtshan dpe rab rdzogs padma gar gyi lcam: khams gsum dbang sdud sna tshogs gar tu bsgyur: rig byed dbang mo'i sku la 374)phyag 'tshal bstod: gsung dbyangs 'gags med yan lag drug cu'i sgras: skal bzang 'gro la bde chen chos sgra sgrogs: ngag gi dbang phyug shes rab pha rol phyin: rig byed lha mo'i gsung la= thugs ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang mo'i thugs: bde stong mngon gyur smra bsam brjod las 'das: chags bral sor rtogs ye shes chos kyi sku: rig byed lha mo'i thugs la= yon tan yongs rdzogs utpal mda' gzhu yis: srid zhi dbang sdud yid bzhin nor la dbang: gang 'dod dngos grub 'byung gnas bcom ldan ma: rig byed lha mo'i yon tan= thugs rje'i lcags kyu phrin las zhags pa yis: gang yang gzugs su snang ba'i skye 'gro rnams: bde chen ye shes dbyings su sgrol mdzad ma: rig byed lha mo'i phrin las= de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ bcom ldan rig byed lha mo dgongs: ma rig nyon mongs las dbang gis: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang: rtsa ba yan lag nyams chags bshags: dag tshangs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra satwa sogs nas: satwa āḥ de nas yang snying 'dzab dgongs ni: hūm̐: rang nyid rig byed lha mo yi: thugs kar padma nyi 375)ma'i steng: thugs srog hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yon du 'khor: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus srog gi snying por bstim: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol par bzla: oṃ ku ru kulle hriḥswā hāḥ de nas sgrub pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid rig byed lha mo yi: thugs kar utpal 'dab brgyad lter: nyi steng hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba las: 'od 'phros rgyal kun thugs rgyud la: thugs rje byin rlabs ye shes dang: yon tan nus mthu ma lus pa:

'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus srog gi snying por thim: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥswā hāḥ de nas las sbyor ni: hrīḥ rang nyid rig byed lha mo yi: thugs kar utpal 'dab brgyad lter: nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor dbus: hrīḥyig dmar po'i mtha' ma la: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba las: 'od zer snod bcud zhing la phog: 'gro ba'i las sgrib bag chags bcom: snyan grags tshe bsod dpal 'byor dngaḥ dbang thang longs spyod ma lus pa: bsdus te sngags phreng nyid 376)la thim: snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum du rol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥ nṛ hring dzaḥlo ka ratna sarba pa shaṃ ku ru swā hāḥ smra bcad mi tshig ma 'dres par: bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag bcu: sgrub pa'i tshad ni de bzhin dpog: las sbyor 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub: bzla tshe dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: dmigs gnad ldan pa zab rgyas chings: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i grogs yo byad: gsang zhing gsang ba dam rgyas chings: 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i klong: 'khor 'das chos kun gnad kyis chings: de ltar dmigs gnad ldan pa yis: bdun phrag gsum gyis rje btsun ma: zhal gzigs byin brlabs dngos grub thob: snang sems dbang 'dus don gnyis 'grub: tshe bsod dpal 'byor longs spyod ldan: gang 'brel mkha' spyaud zhing khams su: skye ba 'di ru 'khod par nges: sa ma ya: de nas rjes kyi rim pa la: bcom ldan lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du: rnam gsum dag pa chen po yis: nyams chags bskang dang tshogs rdzogs phyir: 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa dang: bza' bca' la sogs 'du ba'i tshogs: sha chang med du mi rung zhing: 'byor tshad thabs shes rdzas rnams bshams: lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: byin gyis brlab pa 'di skad do: hrīḥ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: ye shes rang rtsal cho 'phrul du: sbyong 377)spel sgyur ba'i ye shes 'phros: thabs shes 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs:

dngos 'byor yid sprul la sogs pa: nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis brlabs: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams nas: 'od snang mtha' yas gtso dang 'khor: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: ri bo gru 'dzin zhing khams nas: thugs rje'i bdag nyid gtso dang 'khor: 'du ba tshogs kyi= rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams nas: padma thod phreng gtso= 'du ba= bde chen dbang gi zhing= padma gar dbang= 'du ba= lho phyogs dbang gi zhing= rig byed lha mo gtso= 'du ba= dbu skra zur phud ta la la: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus rgyan g.yer kha si li li: dri zhim ngad pa thu lu lu: phaṭa dang pheṃ sgra sangs se sang: byin rlabs na bun thibs se thib: dngos grub sbrang char si li li: rdo rje'i glu gar khrigs se khrig: zhabs gnyis gar stabs shigs se shig: ye shes sgyu ma'i cho 378)'phrul du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: thabs shes pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: dam tshig rten dang dbyer med par: ye shes chen por gnyis med bzhugs: badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ padma ka ma la ye st+wam̐:

de nas bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: oṃ: rang byung lhun grub byang chub sems: snang stong ye shes gnyis med sbyor: thabs shes dwangs ma bdud rtsi'i bcud: dam tshig gsang ba'i bdud rtsi sman: bcom ldan rig byed lha mo yi: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la 'bul: bde stong zhen bral ngang du bzhes: dga' bzhi mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hiḥ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: āḥ padma'i snod du thabs shes bcud: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi rdzas: bsam mi khyab pa'i mchod pa 'di: bcom ldan dbang gis lha mor 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hiḥ de nas thugs dam bskang ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos nyid gzhi las rang shar ba'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang: māṃ sa dza gad thod rnga'i sgra: gling bu dbyangs snyan bshugs glu 379)bcas: rnam gsum dag pa chen po yis: bde chen mgon po snang mtha' yas: rigs bdag bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: snying rje'i mnga' bdag pad dkar 'chang: spyan ras gzigs kyi= rnama'adren sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso: padma 'byung gnas= gsang sngags snying po'i drod 'chang ba: ye shes mtsho rgyal= log rtog tshar gcod he ru ka: padma gar dbang= khams gsum dbang sdud 'phags ma sgrol: rig byed lha mo'i= sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer: gter srung dam can= khyed rnams thugs dam bskangs nas kyang: nyams chags ma lus kun byang nas: mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ dbang gi lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du: sgo gsum bag med ci bgyis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya: sogs nas: satwa āḥ de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis: gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dgra bgegs bkug: ye shes las grub kī la yas: mtshan bcas mtshan med dbyings su bsgral:

gnyis 380)snang 'khrul 'khor dbyings su shig: sarba sha truṃ ru tra mā ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas bstabs pa ni: hūm̐: bdag med rtogs pa'i he ru kas: dug lnga'i ru tra bsgral ba'i rdzas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstab: 'khrul med ye shes sa thob shog: ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta la khā hiḥ de nas tshogs la rol ba ni: kyai: lus gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: kha ya rkan rgyal ba 'od dpag med: lce yum mchog gsang ba gos dkar mo: de gnyis med sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi myong: gnas mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru: lha zhi khro dkyil 'khor rab 'byams la: thabs shes rab bla med gsang ba'i rdzas: longs spyod mchog tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: gtsang rme yi gnyis rtog dang bral ba'i: don tshims pa drug ldan ngang du rol: e ma hoḥ a la la hoḥ de nas lhag ma ni: a kā ro yis byin brlabs nas: pheṃ bhyo: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag la dbang: dpa' bo ging dang mkha' la 'gro: dur khrod gnas nyul lhag len rnams: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor bshal chu bzhes: sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang: dbang gi 381)phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba u tstshiṣṭa bha liṃ ta khā hiḥ de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ lho phyogs dbang gi pho brang nas: sor rtogs ye shes bcom ldan ma: rig byed lha mo gtso dang 'khor: bzhengs shig chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul: mdzod cig dbang gi phrin las mdzod: dug lnga dug gsum dgra bgegs sgrol: srid gsum skye dgu'i blo yid khug: tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang 'phel: bshad sgrub bstan pa dar ba dang: bstan 'dzin tshe srings don gnyis 'grub: dbang gis las rnams myur 'grub mdzod: de nas chad tho ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum dus med dus kyi tshe: sku gsum rgyal ba ston 'khor gyis: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rig rtsal bka' srung dregs tshogs kyis:

so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs bzhin: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhais la: dbang gi phrin las bsgrub pa dang: gsang sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa skyongs: rnal 'byor 'dod don lhun grub mdzod: de nas bstan skyong ni: bhyo: padma thod phreng bka' dam bzhin: gnas pa'i bod skyong bstan ma'i tshogs: bshal chu'i gtor 382)ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags sgrub pa'i bar chad sol: dam ldan rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod: lta log bstan pa bsnubs nas kyang: gsang sngags bstan pa dar zhing rgyas: bstan 'dzin tshe srings phrin las sgrubs: bcol ba'i las rnams kun 'grub mdzod: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ i daṃ bha liṃ ta khā hiḥ de nas bro mnan ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ e las srid pa'i hom khung du: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i dam sri rnams: gnyis med ye shes chen pos mnan: bdag med lta ba'i he ru kas: chos nyid rol pa'i bro brdung zhing: dug gsum las bskyed dgra bgegs tshogs: rig pa ri rab chen po'i 'og: 'pho 'gyur med par mnan nas kyang: ye shes rol pas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: sarba shā truṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan: mchod bstod bya zhing dngos grub bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rje btsun bcom ldan rig byed lha mo yi: gsang gsum byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus kun: rnal 'byor sgo gsum bum pa'i snod du bskyil: thun mong khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub stsol: sku gsum lhun grub mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol: bcu drug rdo rje 'dzin 383)pa'i sa thob nas: nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya siddhi oṃ: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi hrīḥ de nas lhag chad bskang ba ni: hoḥ bcom ldan dbang gi lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag ma rig sgrib gsum dbang gis ni: cho ga bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin nyams pa dang:

sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci bgyis pa: bzod gsol dag tshangs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dbyangs gsal yi ge brgya pa brjod: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag gis ci bsags dge ba kun: srid pa'i 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: kun kyang 'khrul med sa thob shog: de nas smon lam ni: hrīḥ skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du: rje btsun lha mo'i zhal mthong nas: 'bral med bde stong ye shes spel: don gnyis dpal spyod 'dod dgu dbang: bde chen ye shes rang zhal mjal: dang po'i sangs rgyas mngon gyur nas: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: de nas gshegs bsdu ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings stong pa'i klong nas bzhengs pa'i lha: gzhi 384)dbyings ka dag chos sku'i ngang du bsdu: bdag snang dam tshig sems dpa' 'od gsal klong: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgya'i sa ma dhi āḥ de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ byin rlabs dpal mnga' bla ma'i bkra shis shog: dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam= khams gsum dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i= gzhi grol nyon mongs dgra rgyal ba'i: nad gdon zhi dang tshe bsod rgyas: khams gsum dbang sdud log 'dren sgrol: phrin las mtha' rgyas bkra shis gang: dbang gi lha mo'i bden stobs kyis: bkra shis kun las bkra shis pa: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: srid mtha'i bar du dar rgyas shog: me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis ci rigs brjod: 'di ni sgrub pa kun gyi snying po mchog: bskyed pa rtsol bral chu nang nya 'phar bzhin: gsal dag brtan gsum tshad phebs chos kyi sku: rdzogs pa a don bco brgyad dgongs pa mchog: chos dbyings ngang las g.yo med lhun grub che: mi g.yo spros bral chos sku'i rang zhal mjal: sa ma ya: de nas mdun bskyed 'bar ba'i cho ga ni: bsreg dkyil zla gam dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dbus: dbang shing tsan dan dmar pos zla gam brtsigs:

bud shing shug dmar dbang gi shing rigs dang: mar khu yam shing gsang rdzas rnam pa gsum: dbang gi me tog rigs dang 'bru sna rdzas: ci 'byor dngos yid mchod pa dpag 385) med bsags: rang nyid lha mo'i nga rgyal ldan pa'i ngang: dang po bsregs rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros pa yis: mchod rdzas ma dag bsregs gtor bkrus: sbyangs bsgyur spel bas bdud rtsi che: ye shes lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas: zag med mchod sprin chen por gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ de nas me sbar lhar gsal ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos rnams mi dmigs stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: ye shes me 'bar dbang gi dal: de dbus 'ja' zer 'khrigs pa'i klong: me lha agne rā dza ni: dmar mo khro 'dzum gzi brjid 'bar: phyag gnyis bgrang phreng dgang gzar 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis ra skyes gdan la 'gying: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs nas: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig gyur: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dad pa dag ni dam tshig gis: 'byung ba chen po me yi lha: agne rā dza 'khor 'bangs: 'dir gshages 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs: phrin las rab 'byams dngos grub 386)stsol: badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ tiṣṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ: rang byung dbyings nas lhun grub rtsal: āḥ phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'di: agne rā dza 'khor bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes bzhes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs: rū pa shapda sogs: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bā liṃ ta rakta sarba pū dza khā hiḥ de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ tshangs pa chen po 'bar ba'i lha: las bzhi'i phrin las kun gyi bdag: bsreg cing za ba'i mthu stobs can: agne rā dzar phyag 'tshal bstod:

oṃ agnā ye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ bdun nam nyer gcig gis byon skyems 'bul: de nas yam shing 'bul ba ni: oṃ agnā ye bho dhi bṛkṣa ye swā hāḥ snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad sdus sdus wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ lan bdun gyis 'bul: 'dod gsol ni: hoḥ drang srong agne rā dza khyed rnams la bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa dam pa 'di 'phul ba'i mthus: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi dbang du thun mong khams gsum gyi skye 'gro zas nor longs spyod snyan grags tshe bsod dpal 'byor 387)btsan phyug 'phan dar thams cad dang: mchog tu rig 'dzin bzhi'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur nas don gnyis lhun grub kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig: de nas mar khu 'bul ba ni: oṃ agnā ye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ sham bcas lan bdun dang 'dod gsol gong bzhin dang: de nas rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni: oṃ agnā ye sarba dzñā na pū dza khā hiḥ sham bcas lan bdun 'dod gsol bcas rdzogs mthar: de nas bsreg lha bskyed pa ni: hrīḥ me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che'i nang: zla gam dmar po dbang gi gzhal med khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus: padma nyi ma bam ro'i gdan gyi steng: hrīḥlas skad cig yongs gyur bcom ldan ma: rig byed lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: phyag bzhi'i dang pos thabs shes mda' gzhu 'gengs: 'og gnyis padma'i lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: spyan gsum g.yon gzigs 'gro khams dbang du sdud: thod skam lnga dang dar gyi cod pan 'phur: dar dpyangs rin chen rus rgyan sna tshogs spras: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal rngams 388)brjid mdzes: sku smad stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bklubs: 'od 'bar nyi ma zla ba'i rgyab yol mdzad: srid gsum dbang sdud snang stong sku ru bsgom: spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po bla ma rje: 'od dpag med mgon rnam par lhan ner bzhugs:

spyi bor oṃ dkar mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing de las 'od 'phros pas: rgya gar lho phyogs dbang gi phug pa nas: myur mdzad dpal mo rje btsun rig byed ma: 'khor 'das spyan drangs dam ye ro gcig gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min bde chen zhing khams dang: lho phyogs dbang gi phug pa nas: myur ma dpal mo rig byed ma: khams gsum dbang sdud 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥbadzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung chos dbyings kun bzang mo: sgyu 'phrul snang srid dbang mdzad ma: lhun grub dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: padma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs: gnyis med yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: badzra sa ma 389)ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas byon skyems ni: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar rtsi bcud sman: 'byung ba'i bcud mar nus par ldan: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bde ba chen po'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥsarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ bdun nam nyer gcig gis phul: de nas mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid ye dag mchod pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di: bcom ldan rig byed lha mo la: bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir 'bul: dgyes bzhes 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥbadzra arghaṃ sogs: shapda rū pa sogs: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta rakta bo dhi tsitta gu hya pū dza khā hiḥ de nas mar khu 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang stong gnyis med ye shes sbyor: bde chen bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dgyes bzhes dgos 'dod dngos grub stsol: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥsarba dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ snang srid mos bzhi 'dod dgu'i longs spyod tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ

bdun nam nyer gcig gis phul: 390) 'dod gsol ni: hoḥ rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa dam pa 'di phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lha sngags ting nge 'dzin g.yel ba'i nyams chags 'gal 'khrul thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang: khyad par du khams gsum gyi skye 'gro zas nor laungs spyod 'dod dgu'i dpal yon thams cad dbang du 'du zhing mnga' thang chos srid thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas yam shing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'byung ba lnga yi lha mos rab bskyed pa'i: 'bras bu shing mchog dag pa dbang gi rdzas: rig byed lha mo'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dgyes bzhes snod bcud dbang sdud dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ bho dhi bṛkṣa ye swā hāḥ sngags sham bcas nyer gcig dang 'dod gsol bya: de nas rdzas 'dus 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sangs rgyas spyan mas rab bskyed pa'i: gang 'dod rtsi bcud 'bras bu sman: sna tshogs dbang rdzas mchod pa 'di: bdag cag nyams pa bskang ba dang: chags pa sor chud phyir du yang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs mchog thun gyi: 391)dngos grub 'bad med bdag la stsol:

rtsa sngags mthar: sarba pañtsa dzñā na pū dza khā hiḥ sngags sham 'dod gsol bcas brgya stong khri ci rigs 'bul: 'bum tsho gcig gis mchog thun gyi: dngos grub ma lus thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: sbyor ba me yi las sbyor gyi dmigs rim zab mo ni: bar skabs rnams su: mdun bskyed lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam par 'phros pas byang phyogs gter gyi gzhal yas nas nor bdag rnam sras dzam lha rigs lnga la sogs pa nor lha gter bdag thams cad 'od kyi snar drangs nas srog 'phrog nus pa btson du bzung nas gnas dang gzhal yas khang bsod nams 'byor pa zas nor longs spyod dang rin chen gyi dngos po thams cad sprin bzhin du bsdus nas rang gi gnas rten la yang yang thim pas mer gyis gang bar bsam: de bzhin du mdun bskyed lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs lta bu 'phros nas 'gro ba pho rnams kyi snying ga dang mo rnams kyi gsang bar phog pas gang dmigs pa'i yul de skad cig rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas bka' nyan las byed cing bran du khas blangs nas mdun du 'khod de: zas nor longs spyod dpal 'byor bsod nams mnga' thang snyan grags rigs rgyud btsan phyug 'phan dar thams cad bsdus nas bdag nyid la thim bas mnga' dbang 'byor bar bsam pa sogs dmigs 392) pa'i lde kha bsgyur ba la mkhas shing shes par bya ba gnad dam pa yin no: de nas rdzas rnams rdzogs pa'i mthar gos zung 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos: mtshan nyid rab rdzogs reg bya 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dgyes bzhes bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shog: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badzra wāst+ra ye swā hāḥ lan bdun gyis 'bul: de nas so rtsi 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde stong ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir: ro nus stong ldan rdzas mchog 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul:

dgyes bzhes dngos grub 'bad med stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badzra tam bu la ye swā hāḥ lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis phul: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos nyid dbyings nas ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: bcom ldan 'das ma khams gsum dbang mdzad ma: rig byed lha mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas gtang rag 'bul ba ni: phyi nang gsang mchod sngags 'bul mthar: gshegs skyems mar khu 'bul ba ni: rtsa sngags mthar: pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig gis phul nas rdzas gzhan rnams kyang bdun res phul ba sogs mthar: gong bzhin bstod cing de 393) nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor lha: khams gsum dbang mdzad phrin las dpal mnga' ba: bcom ldan lha mo'i gsang gsum mnyam sbyor ba'i: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub ma lus kun: da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya siddhi oṃ: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi hrīḥ de nas gshegs gsol ni: hūm̐: thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: shes rab stong dbyings chen por āḥ bdag cag 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badzra muḥ de nas me lha lngar bzhin gsal: phyi nang gsang mchod sngags 'bul mthar: gshegs skyems 'bul ba ni: oṃ agnā ye sarba pū dza khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul nas rdzas rnams rdzogs mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod bya: thab tu yungs dkar gtor nas yig brgya brjod: de nas gshegs sol ni: oṃ: khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: las rnams 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: mi gnas dbyings su gshegs nas kyang: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur nas bgegs rnams 394) gzhom par bsam: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ bcom ldan dbang gi lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du:

bdud rtsisreg blugs phul ba'i bsod nams dang: dmigs bcas dmigs med dge bsags thams cad kun: mar gyur 'gro ba sems can yongs la bsngo: de nas smon lam ni: hoḥ bcom ldan rig byed lha mo la: 'gro rnams sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: bdag gis ji ltar smon pa bzhin: srid zhi'i dpal 'byor dbang thob nas: lha mo khyed zhal mjal ba dang: bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rtsa gsum lha yi thugs rje dang: rig byed lha mo'i byin rlabs kyis: srid zhi'i phun tshogs bkra shis gang: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir shog: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: 'di ni shin tu gsang ba'i chos: rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs nas: las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med 'grub: khyad par bstan gnyis 'dzin pa yi: skyes bu rnams kyi bstan pa'i btsas: mchog gi yid bzhin nor dang mtshungs: rtsol med gang 'dod dngos grub thob: bden brdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: padma bdag gi bkas mi bslu: dkon pa'i chos zab lam mchog gyur: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod: sa ma ya: 395) e ma shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa: padma'i thugs dam mkha' 'gro'i snying gi khrag: tshag med them yig med pa'i zab chos las: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i gdams pa 'di: mtsho rgyal khyod kyi thugs dam mthil du zungs: rdo rje zhi ba mtsho la brda dbang bskur: da lta ma spel rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs 'dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham la: 'gro rnams dbul zhing bde skyid chung ba dang: mi 'dod rkyen ngan nad gdon ma nges 'byung: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i 'dul bya mdzad phrin nyams: dmag 'khrugs mu ge char chu dus mi snyoms: lo 'bras bcud nyams 'phel stobs nus pa chung: nang dme 'thab rtsod dus ngan rang rtags ngoms: de dus mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i zas chos 'di: mi bsrun bdud khams 'dul phyir khyod sprul ni:

dī paṃ tā re su kha badzra rtsal: nga sprul thabs mchog dpa' bo dang 'phrad nas: smon lam gtad rgya sad nas chos 'di bton: 'gro don shar dang lho nas rim gyis 'byung: thabs grogs chos bdag smon lam dbang gis 'phrad: padma rdzong nas gser gyi pha waṃ 'byung: bu slob stong phrag blo sems chos la btsud: rdo rje'i rdzong la smon lam dbang gis 'grod: chos 'di'i bstan pa mthar rgyas yun brtan 'gyur: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can dang 'di ma 'phrad: rang rgyal 'dod sred 396)
